column4: ColoRIX RIX3: RECOIL has no support. Layout per the Encyclopedia of Graphics File Formats (RIX). Output has the same pixel indices as Deark colorix; 6-bit palette values are scaled v*4+v/16 as elsewhere in the registry, so colours differ from Deark's rounded scaling by at most 1 level
